<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.0732, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.0659 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few millidaltons is C₉H₁₁NO₃ (exact monoisotopic mass = 181.0739 Da, ~8 mDa high, acceptable for a single‑charge ESI measurement). This formula satisfies the required format CxHyOzX, where X represents the nitrogen atom.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
